package desync

import "reflect"

func WindowsModelEndpointRooted(l *Lease) bool {
 l.mu.Lock(); defer l.mu.Unlock()
 v := reflect.ValueOf(l).Elem().FieldByName("retainedEndpoint")
 return v.IsValid() && !v.IsNil()
}

// Included only by the reversible Windows-source offline overlay.
func WindowsModelHeldBytes(e *Engine) int64 { return e.heldBytes.Load() }
func WindowsModelLocksAvailable(l *Lease) bool {
 if !l.engine.mu.TryLock() { return false }; l.engine.mu.Unlock()
 if !l.mu.TryLock() { return false }
 flows:=make([]*flowState,0,len(l.udpFlows));for _,f:=range l.udpFlows{flows=append(flows,f)}
 l.mu.Unlock()
 for _,f:=range flows { if !f.mu.TryLock(){return false};f.mu.Unlock() }
 return true
}
